rationale: The Latin anchors *ictus*, *plaga*, and *percussio* all denote a blow or striking action, pointing to a forceful physical impact rather than any specialised sporting, medical, or graphical sense. Among the candidates, stroke.n.12 ("a single complete movement") is the most general and literal sense of a blow/strike, best accommodating the Latin equivalents; stroke.n.01 is narrowed to sports contexts and is less appropriate for the violent martial/physical blows implied by *plaga* and *percussio* in the Chronicle and Gospel attestations.
